## Pricing Page Analysis

I've reviewed `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.pricing.tsx` and related files. Here's the complete breakdown:

### 1. **UI Structure & Plan Cards**

The pricing page displays **3 plan tiers** in a responsive 3-column grid (via Polaris `InlineGrid`):

**Plan Card Layout:**
- **Plan Name** with badges (Pro has "Most popular" badge, current plan has "Active" badge)
- **Description** (small text, tone="subdued")
- **Price Display:**
  - Free: Shows "Free" + "forever"
  - Paid: Shows `${displayPrice}/month` with annual savings info below
- **CTA Button** (changes text based on context)
- **Features List** (5-6 items per plan with green checkmark icons)

**Feature Lists:**
- **Free:** "Up to 25 zip codes", "Allowed zip codes only", "Basic storefront widget", "Standard email support"
- **Pro:** "Unlimited zip codes", "Allowed + Blocked zip codes", "Delivery zones & ETAs", "Bulk CSV import & export", "Customer waitlist", "Priority email support"
- **Ultimate:** "Everything in Pro", "Advanced delivery rules", "Customisable widget CSS", "API access", "24/7 VIP support", "Early access to new features"

### 2. **Plan Selection & Upgrade Action Handler**

**Loader (lines 102-122):**
- Calls `billing.check()` with all paid plans
- Syncs subscription from Shopify
- Falls back to `getShopSubscription()` if check fails
- Returns current `subscription` object

**Action Handler (lines 126-175):**
- **"subscribe" intent:** Calls `billing.request()` with selected plan, returns `confirmationUrl` for Shopify billing page
- **"cancel" intent:** Calls `billing.cancel()`, then `cancelShopSubscription()`, downgrades to free with proration
- Redirects to Shopify billing confirmation (`window.open(..., "_top")`)

**Button Logic (lines 214-250):**
- **Current plan:** "Current plan" (disabled)
- **Free → Paid:** "Start 14-day free trial"
- **Paid → Free:** "Downgrade to Free" (critical tone)
- **Paid → Higher tier:** "Upgrade to {PlanName}"
- **Paid → Lower paid:** "Switch to {PlanName}"

### 3. **Trial & Billing Toggle**

**Trial:**
- **14-day free trial** for all paid plans (shown in footer text, lines 491-501)
- Message: "All paid plans include a 14-day free trial. No credit card charged until the trial ends."

**Annual vs Monthly Toggle (lines 343-469):**
- **Segmented button group** (fully Polaris, centered) with:
  - "Monthly" button
  - "Annual · Save 20%" button
- Below toggle: Badge showing "You save up to 36% per year" when Annual is selected
- Pricing adjusts: Monthly shows `${monthlyPrice}`, Annual shows `${annualMonthlyPrice}/mo` with total annual cost

**Pricing Data:**
- Pro: $12.99/month or $8.25/month ($99/year)
- Ultimate: $24.99/month or $16.58/month ($199/year)

### 4. **Downgrade/Cancel Flow**

**Modal Confirmation (lines 509-553):**
- Opens when user clicks "Downgrade to Free"
- Title: "Downgrade to Free plan?"
- Lists **7 features lost** (unlimited zip codes, blocked areas, delivery zones, etc.)
- **Warning banner:** "Zip codes over the 25-entry limit will remain saved but become inactive until you upgrade again."
- Destructive "Yes, downgrade" button + "Keep current plan" secondary action

### 5. **Navigation to Pricing Page**

**Sidebar (app.tsx, lines 65-73):**
- Navigation is Shopify's `<s-app-nav>` component (native web components)
- Current links: Dashboard, Zip Codes, Delivery Rules, Waitlist, Widget Customization, Settings, Help & Support
- **NOTE:** Pricing page is NOT in the sidebar navigation

**How Users Reach It:**
- **Dashboard upgrade prompts:**
  - Free plan banner (top) with "Upgrade to Pro" action
  - Usage warning banner at 60%+ capacity with "Upgrade to Pro" button
- **Dashboard navigation card section** may include link (need to verify app._index.tsx more fully)
- Direct URL: `/app/pricing`

### 6. **Current Subscription State**

**Banners at Top (lines 404-436):**
- **Free plan:** "You're on the Free plan" (info tone) with upgrade action
- **Paid plans:** "{PlanName} plan" success banner with feature description

**Status Tracking:**
- `subscription.planTier` → "free" | "pro" | "ultimate"
- `subscription.billingInterval` → "monthly" | "annual"
- `subscription.shopifySubscriptionId` → Shopify's subscription ID
- `subscription.status` → "active" or other Shopify states
